name: JellyBlindTest
description: Play a short random song preview and guess the title.
overview: Adds a five-round blind test game using songs from the signed-in user's Jellyfin library.

versions.changelog: - Warn when a selected audio playlist has fewer songs than the configured rounds.
- Add a source menu to play from the whole audio library or a selected audio playlist.
- Allow repeated guesses until reveal and show expected versus submitted answers for every round.
- Require over 80% fuzzy title and artist similarity, award both categories independently, and require a strict artist majority for collaborations.
- Accept 80% fuzzy song and artist matches, award up to two points per round, and require a strict artist majority for collaborations.
- Keep the answer field open while a single Guessing timer runs, continue music through reveal, and crossfade between songs.
- Merge preview and answer into one guessing phase, continue playback, and crossfade tracks between rounds.
- Inline the menu SVG, inherit the theme color, and make the question mark transparent.
- Straighten the paired noteheads and stems, and add an editable standalone SVG menu icon.
- Redesign the Blind Test menu icon as paired music notes with a circled question mark.
- Add a mirrored music-note SVG icon to the Blind Test main-menu link.

- Start the song with each round, show Music and Answer countdowns, reveal on timeout, and advance automatically after configurable reveal playback.
- Add configurable answer and reveal durations to Blind Test Settings.
- Fix the Settings link route from the embedded game back to Jellyfin Web.
- Fix the game script initialization after loading the page through Jellyfin's same-origin iframe.
- Fix iframe startup by avoiding a duplicate ApiClient declaration.
- Load the game in a same-origin page frame so its scripts run under Jellyfin Web's security policy.
- Add a regular Jellyfin user-navigation link that opens the Blind Test outside Dashboard.
- Keep game settings in a separate Dashboard plugin page.
- Show post-answer album artwork as a translucent background in the stage card.
- Fix the final-round button to use the configured round count.
- Add an admin-only Settings link to the main game page and request album image metadata for reliable post-answer artwork.
- Add a main-menu game page, separate admin settings, configurable rounds and preview duration, and post-answer album artwork.
- Label the initial preview action as Play and switch it to Replay after playback.
- Render the Blind Test as a Jellyfin Web page fragment and avoid translation parsing of JavaScript template literals.
- Add a five-round random blind test with five-second song previews and typed title answers.
